DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you calling about a package?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 朝、家の玄関先に紙袋が置かれていました。私への配達か分からず、まだ中は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 玄関の不明紙袋を未開封で相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: This morning, there was a paper bag outside my front door. I don't know whether it was delivered for me, so I haven't looked inside yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are asking about an unidentified paper bag at your front door that you have not opened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前や住所が書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does it have a name or address written on it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 何も書いてありません。知人が来る予定も聞いていないので、誰が置いた物か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 記名宛名予定訪問なしで置いた人不明と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is nothing written on it. I haven't heard that any acquaintances were planning to visit, either, so I don't know who left it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that there is no name or address, no expected visit, and you do not know who left it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今、どこへ置いてありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見つけた所に置いたままです。今は家族が家にいますが、何の袋か分からず心配しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋は発見場所のままで在宅家族も不安に感じていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've left it where I found it. My family is at home now, and they're worried because they don't know what the bag is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the bag is still where you found it and your family at home is also worried.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お困りの状況を担当へ伝えます。いつ見つけましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the person in charge about your situation. When did you find it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 七時ごろです。昨夜帰った時には気づかなかったのですが、夜に誰かが置いたのを見たわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 七時発見と前夜未認知を区別し設置時刻断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Around seven o'clock. I didn't notice it when I came home last night, but I didn't actually see anyone leave it during the night.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you found it at seven and did not notice it the previous evening, distinguishing those facts without claiming when it was left.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 置いた人を見かけたということではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: So you did not see the person who left it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、置いた人は見ていません。袋がまだ玄関先にあることも含めて、担当の方に状況を説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 設置者は見ておらず袋が現在も玄関先にあると担当へ説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: That's right, I didn't see who left it. I'd like to explain the situation to the person in charge, including the fact that the bag is still outside the front door.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain to the person in charge in Japanese that you did not see who left it and that the bag is still outside the front door.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当が状況を伺います。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: The person in charge will ask you about the situation, then. Thank you for contacting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封筒をお出しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to mail this envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも封を貼った所がまだ湿っています。ほかの郵便物に付くのではないかと心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 封の糊が湿り他郵便へ付く不安を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But the part I glued shut is still wet. I'm worried it might stick to other mail.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the glue on the seal is wet and you are worried it may stick to other mail.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表面に糊がはみ出しているようですね。ご自身で整えてからお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: It looks as though some glue has seeped onto the surface. Please tidy it up yourself before handing it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 外側にはみ出していますね。封筒を整えるために、少し置いて作業できる所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: はみ出した糊を確認し封筒を整える作業場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it's seeped onto the outside. Is there somewhere I can put the envelope down for a moment and work on it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the excess glue and ask in Japanese for a place to work on tidying the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この作業台で準備できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can prepare it on this worktable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この台を使います。糊が台に付かないよう自分の紙を敷いて、はみ出した所を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己紙を敷いて台への貼付きに配慮し糊の状態を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll use this table. I'll put down my own sheet of paper so the glue doesn't stick to the table and check where it has seeped out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will put your own paper underneath to prevent sticking to the table and check the glue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 封筒の外側に、ほかに貼り付きそうな所はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are there any other places on the outside of the envelope that might stick?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 裏の角だけでした。今は表面が乾いて、紙にも付かなくなりました。封が閉じているかも見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 裏角の乾燥と閉鎖状態を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was just the corner on the back. The surface is dry now and no longer sticks to the paper. I'll also check that the envelope is sealed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that the back corner is dry and check that the envelope is closed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備が済みましたら、こちらへお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once it's ready, please hand it in here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 閉じた所は開いていません。下に敷いた自分の紙は外し、封筒一つだけを出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 敷紙を除いて閉じた封筒だけ提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: The sealed part hasn't opened. I'll remove my sheet of paper from underneath and hand in just the one envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will remove the underlying paper and submit only the sealed envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらを確認いたします。ご準備ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check it, then. Thank you for getting it ready. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: このご案内について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about this notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 満期と書いてあります。この日になったら、キャッシュカードも使えなくなるのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 定期満期日でカード失効するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says maturity. Does that mean my cash card will also stop working on this date?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the cash card expires on the term deposit's maturity date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内の満期は、定期預金の期間についての記載です。カードの交換日ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The maturity mentioned in this notice refers to the term of your fixed-term deposit. It is not a card replacement date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: カードの交換日だと思って、手帳にそう書いてしまいました。定期預金の日付なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 満期をカード交換日として手帳に書いた誤りを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was the card replacement date and wrote that in my planner. So it's the date for the fixed-term deposit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you mistakenly wrote the maturity date in your planner as the card replacement date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、こちらの定期預金の期間です。満期の時のお取扱いもご相談になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, it refers to the term of this fixed-term deposit. Would you also like to discuss what happens when it matures?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相談したいです。手帳のメモも、定期預金の満期日と直しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手帳の誤記を定期預金の満期日へ直し満期後の扱いを相談したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please. I'll also correct the note in my planner to say the maturity date of the fixed-term deposit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will correct your planner to the fixed-term deposit's maturity date and want to discuss what happens after maturity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 満期後の扱いは、ご契約の内容を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check your contract to see how it is handled after maturity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内と通帳を持って来ました。この定期預金が満期になると、どうなるのか説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 満期後の扱いを確認する資料として案内と通帳を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've brought the notice and my bankbook. I'd like to hear an explanation of what happens when this fixed-term deposit matures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the notice and bankbook in Japanese as documents for checking what happens after maturity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その二つを担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show both of those to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。満期は定期預金の話とメモし、カードを交換する依頼ではなく、満期後の扱いを確認したいと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: カード交換依頼でなく定期満期後扱い確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll note that maturity refers to the fixed-term deposit and explain that I'm asking what happens after it matures, rather than requesting a card replacement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are checking what happens after the term deposit matures, rather than requesting a card replacement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へご案内いたします。資料をお持ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take you to the person in charge, then. Please bring your documents. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: かぼちゃをお選びでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この大きい物を買いたいですが、棚から持ち上げると手が滑りそうです。手伝っていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 棚の大かぼちゃを滑りそうなので取ってほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to buy this large one, but I'm afraid my hands might slip when I lift it off the shelf. Could you help me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for help taking the large pumpkin off the shelf because your hands might slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらのかぼちゃですか。指で示していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which pumpkin? Could you point to it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 奥の緑色の一個をお願いします。こちらから指している物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 奥の緑色のかぼちゃ一個を指して特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The green one at the back, please. It's the one I'm pointing to from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out and identify the one green pumpkin at the back in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらでお取りします。かごは、台へ置いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll get it for you. Could you put your basket on the counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 台へ置きました。ほかの商品を下敷きにしないよう、卵は先に端へ移します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: かごを台へ置き卵を退ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've put it on the counter. I'll move the eggs to the side first so the other items don't end up underneath it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have put the basket on the counter and are moving the eggs aside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: かぼちゃを入れました。かご全体も重くなりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've put the pumpkin in. The whole basket is getting heavy too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 重いので、かごはカートに載せて運びます。丸ごとのかぼちゃ一個でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 重いかごはカートを使い丸ごと一個購入と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's heavy, so I'll put the basket on a cart to carry it. I'd like one whole pumpkin, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will use a cart for the heavy basket and are buying one whole pumpkin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのままレジへお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take it to the checkout as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: カートへ載せられました。卵も別に置けたので、かぼちゃを転がさず会計へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: かごと卵を安定させ会計へ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've managed to put it on the cart. The eggs are separate too, so I'll go to the checkout without letting the pumpkin roll around.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the basket and eggs are stable and you are heading to the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お足元にお気をつけて。お買い上げありがとうございます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please watch your step, then. Thank you for your purchase. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 水飲み場について、お尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the drinking fountain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。走って靴が泥だらけになりました。この水で靴を洗ってよい所でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水飲み設備で泥靴を洗えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My shoes got covered in mud while I was running. Is this somewhere I can use the water to wash my shoes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether muddy shoes can be washed at the drinking-water facility.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは飲み水のための設備です。靴を置いて洗う場所ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This facility is for drinking water. It is not a place to put down and wash shoes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 飲み口に靴を近づけないようにします。手を洗う設備も、別に探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 飲口に靴を近づけず手洗い場所を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll keep my shoes away from the spout. I'd also like to find a separate place to wash my hands.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will keep your shoes away from the drinking spout and ask for a place to wash your hands.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: トイレの横に手洗いがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a handwashing area next to the toilets.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 場所が分かりました。先に手を洗ってから、靴の手入れは家でします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定設備で手を洗い靴の手入れは家ですると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I know where it is now. I'll wash my hands first and take care of my shoes at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will wash your hands at the indicated facility and take care of your shoes at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路に泥が落ちた場合は、お知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please let us know if any mud falls onto the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この足元に、靴から少し泥が落ちています。場所を見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 足元に落ちた泥の位置を示して確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: A little mud has fallen from my shoes here by my feet. Could you take a look at the spot?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Point out in Japanese where the mud has fallen by your feet and ask someone to check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらで確認します。お帰りになる前にも、靴の状態にお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check it. Please also be mindful of the condition of your shoes before you leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手洗いへ行きます。靴を替えられるよう家族に連絡し、泥の付いた靴は持参の袋へ入れて持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 履替え靴を家族へ頼み泥靴を袋で持ち帰る計画を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll go to the handwashing area. I'll contact my family so I can change shoes, and I'll put the muddy shoes in the bag I brought and take them home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your plan to ask your family for replacement shoes and take the muddy shoes home in a bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、手洗いへどうぞ。お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23219-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go ahead to the handwashing area, then. Take care on your way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次の列車の乗車位置について、お尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about where to board the next train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いつも六号車の所で待っていますが、次の列車は四両と表示されています。最後尾に乗りたい場合は、どこで待てばよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 次列車四両と普段六号車位置の違いを示し最後尾の待機位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I always wait by car six, but the display says the next train has four cars. Where should I wait if I want to board the last car?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the difference between the next train's four-car formation and your usual car-six position, and ask where to wait for the last car.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 次の列車はこちらの四両用の案内です。最後尾は四号車の乗車位置をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This four-car guide is for the next train. Please check the boarding position for car four for the last car.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 六号車の場所へ列車が来ると思っていました。短い列車の止まる範囲を、案内図で見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 短編成が止まる範囲を案内図で見せてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the train would reach the car-six position. Could you show me on the diagram the area where the shorter train stops?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to be shown on the diagram the stopping area for the shorter train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この図の四両用の範囲です。いつもの六号車の表示より、こちらへ移ることになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: It's the four-car area on this diagram. You will need to move this way from your usual car-six sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この「四両用」は列車の長さですね。「四号車」は、その列車で乗る車両の番号と分けて見ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 四両用の編成長表示と四号車の車両番号を区別して確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: So 'four cars' here means the length of the train. Should I distinguish that from 'car four,' which is the number of the car I board on that train?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check in Japanese the distinction between the four-car train-length indication and the car number, car four.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。四両用の図で、四号車の位置をお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please locate car four on the four-car diagram.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 四号車の位置が見つかりました。荷物があるので、ほかの方の通る所を空けてこちらで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 四号車の場所を見つけ荷物で通路をふさがず待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've found the car-four position. I have luggage, so I'll wait here while leaving room for other people to pass.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you found the car-four position and will wait without blocking the passage with your luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 列車が来ましたら、車両の番号と行き先も表示でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: When the train arrives, please also check its display for the car number and destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待つ位置を確認できました。四両用の停車範囲と四号車の場所を見て、到着する列車の表示も確認してから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停車範囲車両位置と到着列車の行先番号を確認して乗ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've confirmed where to wait. I'll check the four-car stopping area and car-four position, then check the arriving train's display as well before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will board after checking the stopping area, car position, and arriving train's destination and car number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの乗車位置へどうぞ。お荷物と足元にお気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to this boarding position, then. Take care with your luggage and watch your step as you board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご住所に関するご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about your address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一緒に住んでいた人が引っ越しました。水道の請求はその人の名前のままで、相談する連絡先を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 退去同居人名義の水道請求の相談先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The person I was living with has moved out. The water bill is still in that person's name, and I'd like to know whom to contact about it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whom to contact about the water bill in the name of the former housemate who moved out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 水道の担当へ確認してください。請求の案内をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check with the water department. Do you have the billing notice with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。私は同じ家に残っています。住民票を動かす手続きではなく、水道の利用者のことを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分は残るため転居届でなく水道相談と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I'm staying in the same home. I'd like to discuss the water account holder, rather than a procedure to change my registered address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are staying and want to discuss the water account rather than submit a moving notification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この案内の問い合わせ先から、担当を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check the department using the contact details on this notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。同居人とは連絡できます。勝手に名前だけ書き換えず、本人と何を確認するか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勝手に名義書替えず本人との確認事項を聞きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I can contact my former housemate. I'd like to ask what I should confirm with them, rather than just changing the name without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to ask what to confirm with the account holder and will not change the account name without permission.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 名義変更などの条件は、水道の担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The water department will explain the conditions for changing the account name and related matters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しい支払い方法も相談したいです。前の人の口座の情報を私が使うことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧口座情報を使わず自分の支払い方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd also like to discuss a new payment method. I won't use the previous person's bank account information myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will not use the former account information and want to discuss your own payment method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その二つのご用件をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell them about those two matters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 利用者の名前と今後の支払いを相談します。請求の案内を持ち、同居人と連絡が取れることも説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 請求案内と同居人連絡可の状況で二用件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll discuss the account holder's name and future payments. I'll bring the billing notice and also explain that I can contact my former housemate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the two matters in Japanese, with the billing notice and the fact that you can contact your former housemate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当の連絡先をご案内します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll give you the department's contact details, then. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 順番をお待ちですね。どうされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're waiting for your turn, I see. What's wrong?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 採血を待っている間に、目の前が暗くなる感じがしました。立って呼ばれる所へ行くのが不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 採血待ちで暗くなる感じと立つ不安を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: While I was waiting for my blood draw, I felt as though my vision was going dark. I'm worried about standing up and going over when I'm called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the darkening of your vision while waiting for a blood draw and your concern about standing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 立ち上がらず、今いる場所を教えてください。近くへ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't stand up. Tell me where you are now, and I'll come over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 待合の端の椅子です。今は座っています。さっきは水を買いに立った時にふらっとしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 座っている場所と起立時のふらつきを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm in a chair at the edge of the waiting area. I'm sitting now. Earlier, when I stood up to buy water, I felt dizzy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese where you are sitting and that you felt dizzy when standing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その時の様子を確認します。一人でいらっしゃいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check what happened then. Did you come alone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は一人です。採血が怖いだけだと自分で片づけず、今の感じを伝えようと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人受診で怖さだけと自己判断しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm alone today. I thought I should explain how I'm feeling instead of deciding for myself that it's just fear of having blood drawn.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you came alone and will not assume it is only fear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当にもお知らせします。採血を進めるかは、確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll also inform the person in charge. We'll let you know whether to proceed with the blood draw after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。順番を飛ばされるのが心配で黙っていましたが、先に体調を見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 順番より体調確認を先に希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I kept quiet because I was worried about losing my turn, but I'd like someone to check how I'm feeling first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want your condition checked before worrying about your place in line.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 順番のことはこちらで確認します。ほかに感じることがあればお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check about your turn. Please let us know if you feel anything else.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだ少しふらふらします。かばんは足元にあります。自分で別の待合へ歩かず、案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在のふらつきを伝え自己移動せず案内を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'm still a little dizzy. My bag is by my feet. I'll wait for instructions instead of walking to another waiting area on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are still dizzy and will wait for instructions without moving by yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そばで確認しますので、そのままお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll come and check on you, so please stay where you are. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 交通の出来事について、ご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you contacting us about a traffic incident?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 車のカメラに映像が残っています。ただ、走り続けると古い映像が上書きされるようなので、扱いを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車載映像の上書きの心配と資料の扱いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is footage on my car's camera. But it seems older footage gets overwritten if I keep driving, so I'd like to ask how to handle it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss in Japanese your concern about dashcam footage being overwritten and how to handle the material.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの出来事の映像か伺い、資料の扱いは担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll ask which incident the footage shows and direct you to the person in charge about handling the material.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝、交差点で車同士が接触した所を見ました。私は通りかかった側で、現場では既に相談が始まっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今朝目撃した接触と自分は通行側だったことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: This morning, I saw two cars make contact at an intersection. I was passing by, and people at the scene had already started consulting about it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the collision you saw this morning and that you were passing by.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 映像を持っていることを、対応する担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the person handling the incident that you have footage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。自分で必要そうな所だけ切り取る前に、元の状態をどう残すか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切取り前に元データを残す方法を確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Before cutting out only the parts I think might be needed, I'd like to check how to preserve it in its original state.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to check how to retain the original data before cutting out parts.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで機器の操作方法まではご案内できません。資料の相談先を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can't explain how to operate the device here. I'll check whom you should contact about the material.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 機器の保存方法は説明書でも調べます。映像を守るために路上で急停車したり、操作しながら運転したりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 機器操作は説明書を見て運転中に操作しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll also check the manual for how to save footage on the device. I won't stop suddenly on the road or operate it while driving to preserve the footage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will consult the manual for device operation and will not operate it while driving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今は安全な場所に停車していらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are you currently parked somewhere safe?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家の駐車場にいます。電話を終えてから説明書を見て、担当に映像の状態と機種を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自宅駐車中と説明し機種と状態を担当へ知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'm in my parking space at home. After this call, I'll read the manual and tell the person in charge the condition of the footage and the device model.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are parked at home and will tell the person in charge the device model and footage condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。それでは、担当の連絡先をご案内します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll give you the person's contact details, then. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物に合う箱についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a box that fits your shipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鉢植えを送りたいのですが、買った箱に入りそうにありません。鉢の高さだけで箱を選んでしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鉢だけの高さで選んだ箱に鉢植えが入らないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to send a potted plant, but it doesn't look as though it will fit in the box I bought. I chose the box based only on the pot's height.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the potted plant does not fit in the box you chose based only on the pot's height.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 鉢植えの受付や梱包は担当へ確認します。全体が写る写真はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check with the person in charge about accepting and packing potted plants. Do you have a photo showing the whole plant?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この写真です。鉢は十五センチですが、枝の先まで測ると六十センチあります。箱の高さは三十五センチです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真で鉢十五全体六十箱三十五センチの違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's the photo. The pot is fifteen centimeters tall, but it measures sixty centimeters to the tips of the branches. The box is thirty-five centimeters tall.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use the photo to explain in Japanese the difference between the fifteen-centimeter pot, sixty-centimeter total height, and thirty-five-centimeter box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 鉢だけでなく、植物を含む全体の寸法を担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please give the person in charge the overall dimensions including the plant, rather than just the pot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 横幅も枝を含めて測り直します。今の箱へ入れるために枝を折り曲げる前に、合う梱包を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 枝込み幅も再計測し無理に折る前に梱包を相談したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll measure the width again, including the branches. Before bending the branches to fit it into the current box, I'd like to discuss suitable packaging.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will remeasure the width including the branches and want to discuss packaging before forcing the branches to bend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのご希望も担当へ伝えます。今日は鉢植えもお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll pass on that request too. Have you brought the potted plant today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家にあります。箱だけを買い直して持って来るより、先に写真と全体の寸法で受付できるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 植物は自宅で箱購入前に写真寸法で受付可否を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's at home. Before simply buying another box and bringing it in, I'd like to ask whether you can accept it based on the photo and overall dimensions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the plant is at home and you want to check acceptance using the photo and dimensions before buying a box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 送り先も確認します。国内へお送りの予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll also check the destination. Are you planning to send it within Japan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 国内の家族宛てです。六十センチの全体の高さと測り直した幅をメモし、梱包の説明を聞いてから用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 国内家族宛てと全体高さ幅をまとめ説明後に梱包を用意する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: It's for my family within Japan. I'll note the overall height of sixty centimeters and the width after remeasuring it, and prepare the packaging after hearing the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it is for family within Japan, summarize the overall height and width, and say you will prepare the packaging after hearing the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、写真と寸法のメモを担当へお見せください。ご相談の席へご案内します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show the photo and your dimension notes to the person in charge, then. I'll take you to the consultation desk. Goodbye.
